_meta.basis: Company reporting is IFRS (earnings releases, presentations, calls); the model runs on Screener's Ind AS consolidated statements. FY26 revenue is Rs33,593 cr under IFRS and Rs33,700 cr under Ind AS (licence and service income and other operating revenue are classified differently). Ind AS 'other income' includes interest, mutual-fund gains, forex gains and divestment gains that IFRS shows partly in 'other operating income' and 'finance income'. All amounts Rs crore unless stated.
